Looking at this PR, I need to evaluate the rename from `InstrumentationMiddleware` to `MetricsMiddleware`, the move of contextual logger functionality to a separate middleware, and the related changes.

Let me trace through the changes carefully:

1. The old `logger_middleware.go` explicitly extracted a trace ID via `tracing.TraceIDFromContext(ctx, false)` and added it to the log params
2. The new `logger_middleware.go` no longer does this
3. The new `contextual_logger_middleware.go` only adds: endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID, uname - no trace ID
4. Whether trace ID is preserved now depends entirely on whether `pkg/infra/log` auto-correlates with trace context

Also notable: the test file was renamed but the test function `TestInstrumentationMiddleware` (line 21) was not updated to match.

findings.title: Trace ID silently dropped from Plugin Request Completed log
findings.body: The previous logger_middleware.go explicitly extracted the trace ID from the request context and appended it to the log parameters: `traceID := tracing.TraceIDFromContext(ctx, false); if traceID != "" { logParams = append(logParams, "traceID", traceID) }`. This extraction was removed in this PR and the new ContextualLoggerMiddleware only adds endpoint/pluginId/dsName/dsUID/uname to the context logger, not the trace ID. As a result, the 'Plugin Request Completed' log emitted by LoggerMiddleware no longer carries a traceID field unless pkg/infra/log transparently correlates with the OpenTelemetry trace context. This regression is not described in the PR description and removes an important field used for correlating plugin request logs with traces. The author should either restore the explicit extraction in LoggerMiddleware or verify (and document) that the infra/log context logger includes the trace ID automatically.

findings.title: Test function name not updated after rename
findings.body: The file was renamed from instrumentation_middleware_test.go to metrics_middleware_test.go and the type/constructor were renamed to MetricsMiddleware/newMetricsMiddleware/NewMetricsMiddleware, but the top-level test function is still declared as `func TestInstrumentationMiddleware(t *testing.T)`. This is inconsistent with the rename and the test name will be misleading in test output and any -run filters. It should be renamed to TestMetricsMiddleware.
